'''Colony Carriers''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Can spawn naturally, once a [[Colony]] with at least 3 points exists in the dimension, individually with a spawnweight of 1.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Colony Carriers are Heavy Support Units.
*Their melee attack is performed through contact damage.
*Colony Carriers will apply the following effects to nearby parasites:
**Regeneration III (0:30)
**[[Foster]] II (1:00)
**[[Link]] I (0:10)
*Colony Carriers can spawn [[Succor|Succors]].
*Colony Carriers can perform small leaps in liquids.
*Colony Carriers can dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
*Colony Carriers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 15, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 5 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=1|Armored=ArmoredColonyCarrier.png|TextureDesc=has 5 ([[File:Armor.png]][[File:Armor.png]][[File:Halfarmor.png]]) more armor points but a slower moving speed.}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Colony Carriers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
*The back of the Colony Carrier functions as a Weak Point. When this Weak Point is hit, damage inflicted to it is tripled and the [[Bleeding]] Effect is applied to it.
